scientific_integrity: An exact Hall proof and residue-counting argument underpin the infinite statements. Exhaustive finite checks confirm instances but do not substitute for the proof. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-order density is for products of two distinct primes at least five, four indexed progression terms, and fixed k before H tends to infinity. The k asymptotic fixes the primes. No classification for smaller primes, more prime factors, or uniform prime-varying k is asserted; historical priority is uncertain.
title: One shared divisor matching across multiple arithmetic progressions: an all-order semiprime density law
